data.title: The smiling middle-finger statue chairs a tiny boardroom
data.creativeFamily: clean text-free editorial workplace scene built around the product's raised-finger head
data.audience: Pinterest users saving funny coworker gifts, novelty desk decor, white elephant ideas, and quietly unhinged office humor
data.hook: A polished miniature boardroom appears serious until the exact four-inch blue smiling middle-finger statue is seen presiding at the head of the table.

product.name: Junwait blue smiling middle-finger synthetic-resin desk statue (ASIN B0C7J5SMPK)

references.lesson: Preserve one small matte-blue round seated resin character with short blue arms, tiny flesh-tone hands and feet, and one tall flesh-tone middle finger that is also the long smiling face and head. Keep its front silhouette and roughly four-to-five-inch desk scale; do not add a separate raised arm or hand.
